performance.verdict: All paid channels dark since Sep 19; SOW blockers compound the shutdown risk.

findings.text: All paid spend hit $0 from Sep 19–25 (7 straight days); both Meta and Google went dark simultaneously — not a budget pause pattern, likely an account or billing event.
5 SOW milestones overdue (earliest Jul 20): Stripe QA, GHL gap closure, stack re-test, paid landing pages, and UGC batch — all unconfirmed complete as of today.
GHL intake leak: Windsor shows 90 leads vs 109 GHL opportunities from 146 contacts; 0 appointments and 0 won opps — leads arriving but not converting inside CRM.
When active (Sep 1–18), CPL held at ~$16 and leads ran 4–12/day; the 3-day signal (Sep 17–19 vs Sep 14–16) showed spend collapsing from $92/day to $35/day before full stop.
Google Ads spent $362.90 over 28 days with 0 recorded conversions; GA4 sessions held at 13–34/day through the blackout, suggesting organic/direct traffic only now.

suggestions.text: Immediately diagnose and restore paid accounts — identify the billing or policy event that killed $0 spend across both Meta and Google since Sep 19.
suggestions.monday_update: Both Meta and Google Ads have reported $0 spend for 7 consecutive days (Sep 19–25), confirmed across all series data. The immediate action is to audit both ad account dashboards for billing failures, policy flags, or payment method issues and restore to active status. Success is confirmed when daily spend resumes at the pre-pause level (~$90–$105/day Meta, ~$15–$30/day Google) within 48 hours of today (by Sep 28). Do not relaunch campaigns until the cause is identified to avoid repeating the shutdown.

suggestions.text: Resolve GHL intake leak: reconcile 146 contacts vs 90 Windsor leads and investigate why 0 appointments were set from 109 opportunities.
suggestions.monday_update: GHL shows 109 opportunities created from 146 contacts, yet Windsor records only 90 leads and 0 appointments have been booked in the 28-day window. This gap means leads are arriving but are not being actioned or qualified inside the CRM. The fix is to audit the lead-to-opportunity mapping (check Zapier webhook and GHL Products intake path for duplicates or missed fields) and confirm the appointment-booking automation is triggering correctly. Success is a reconciled lead count within 10% between Windsor and GHL, and at least 1 appointment booked within 7 days of campaigns resuming.

suggestions.text: Watch Google Ads efficiency: 0 conversions on $362.90 spend — hold reallocation until pixel/conversion tracking is verified post-relaunch.
suggestions.monday_update: Google Ads recorded 0 conversions against $362.90 in 28-day spend; this is likely a client-side pixel issue (known data gap) rather than confirmed zero performance. Do not reallocate or kill Google budget until campaigns are restored (S1) and conversion tracking is verified firing correctly on the landing page. Re-check on Sep 29 after a minimum of 3 active spend days to assess whether conversions register post-fix.
